title: Enhance NuGet feed selection to support pre-release packages
summary: AL-Go now supports pre-release NuGet packages by adding an `-allowPrerelease` suffix to the nuGetFeedSelectMode setting, enabling developers to include pre-release versions in dependency resolution.
key_points: Pipeline extracts and handles the pre-release flag separately
Enables dependency resolution for pre-release app packages
quote: appending `-allowPrerelease` to the select mode enables searching for pre-release packages
